_comment: Add symbols here. 'kind' picks which upstream sources are queried. Use 'equity' for stocks/ETFs (Nasdaq confirms declared-but-unpaid dividends) and 'fund' for open-end mutual funds (Yahoo history + manual announcements).

symbols.name: Microsoft Corporation
symbols.notes: Declares ~3 months ahead. Historically raises the dividend with the September declaration (first raised payment has a November ex-date).

symbols.name: Fidelity 500 Index Fund
symbols.notes: Income distributions in Apr/Jul/Oct/Dec. Yahoo folds any capital-gain distribution into the same stream.

symbols.name: Fidelity Total Market Index Fund
symbols.notes: Income distributions in Apr and Dec; December typically also carries the capital-gain distribution.
